name: tattoo-quotes
description: Tattoo studio quote manager: clients request quotes with reference images, artists review, reply and price them.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tattoo-quotes/api && npm run build -w @tattoo-quotes/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @tattoo-quotes/api && npm run test -w @tattoo-quotes/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tattoo-quotes/api && npm run typecheck -w @tattoo-quotes/web
